messages:
Alex: Heads-up — NorthSpring is reporting a p99 tail spike after the midday cutover to canary v0.9.4 (rolled 2% -> 100% over ~10m). Customer flagged this P1; they see latency and some 5xx. Need an eng owner for a hotpatch + rollback plan. I can coord customer comms and a 14:00 PT deploy window. Quick triage shows correlation with KV cache eviction behavior (prefix cases).
Maria: I can own the hotpatch. I opened a PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/456 — it reverts the new eviction heuristic and adds a guard for prefix keys. Short test plan in PR. Running `make smoke-customer NORTHSPRING` locally reproduces the tail.
Devon: Oncall SRE here — I can own canary + rollback ops. Please add a feature flag we can toggle: `enable_kv_eviction_v2=false`. Rollback plan: patch the deployment to previous image and scale down canary. Example command to flip flag in k8s: 
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap infer-flags -p '{"data":{"enable_kv_eviction_v2":"false"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime
```
I'll monitor p99 and 5xx. If 5xx > 0.5% for 3m, I'll trigger full rollback.
Tara: CS: NorthSpring says SLA hit will be considered at 6h if not resolved; legal will get involved. They want an ETA and a short plan we can forward to the customer. Please include expected downtime/impact.
June (PM): We need a deploy checklist with assigned roles: who runs the PR merge, who kicks the canary, who is on-monitoring, who contacts the customer at T+30m. Maria — can you add a checklist to the PR and tag owners? Also need ETA for PR review + CI.
deploy-bot: Deploy bot: pipeline started for branch hotfix/northspring-kv-evict (build #987). Status: queued.
Maria: Added checklist to PR with checkboxes and test commands. Requesting quick review from @Devon and @Jordan. ETA: if CI passes, I can cut the hotpatch and request canary at ~13:40 PT (so canary + verification before 14:00 PT window).
Jordan: Infra — we have 2 spare pre-warmed nodes in pool-a; if latency persists we'll scale to 4. No capacity-related constraints for this deploy.
Devon: I'll run the canary once PR is green. Monitoring dashboard: https://dash.redwood/s/northspring — I'll set alerts: p99 +30% and 5xx > 0.5% triggers. I'll annotate alerts so rollback is automatic on the 5xx spike.
Alex: Owners confirmed: Maria = code/hotpatch PR, Devon = canary & rollback ops, Jordan = infra scaling, Alex = customer comms. Target: merge + canary by 13:45 PT, full rollout or rollback decision by 14:00 PT. If no +1 by 13:30 PT we fall back to the rollback plan. Please post PR +1 or blockers here. :thumbsup:
Maria: pinging @Devon for review. small note in PR about the test fixture to validate prefix hits.
Devon: Reviewing now, should be able to +1 in 10–15m if CI green.
Tara: I'll notify NorthSpring of the 14:00 PT window and give them the short plan above. Will escalate internally if ETA slips.
Alex: Thanks all — I'll update this thread after canary. If anything changes, call me (Alex) direct.
